issues: A vacuum environment is not stated or implied; the model instead uses periodic boundary conditions in all directions.
The claimed 300 K, 10^9 s^-1 baseline is imprecise: orientation comparisons were performed at 10 K and 10^9 s^-1, while strain-rate analyses used 300 K.
Categorical claims of no BCC occurrence are too strong: no BCC was found in the orientation study, but local BCC-classified atoms were reported at higher temperatures around disordered atoms.
Deformation was not bounded solely to partial-dislocation slip; sessile stair-rod and 1/6<110> dislocations also contributed.
The proposed contrast with 'smooth phase transformation curves' is not presented as a discriminating test in the paper.
